[RAOT.9.1] The loader processes `CompiledCode` atoms in stream order.  For
each `CompiledCode` atom, it checks `arch` against `DS_ARCH`; mismatches are
silently skipped. Stream order is the order in which `CompiledCode` atoms are
*considered*, not a licence to act on one before the artefact has
verified — see [RAOT.9.5].
